definitions.explanation: A painting executed on the panels of a {屏風|びょうぶ} (folding screen); a major format of traditional Japanese painting.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}で{屏風絵|びょうぶえ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a folding-screen painting at the museum.

examples.japanese: この{屏風絵|びょうぶえ}には{松|まつ}が{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: Pine trees are painted on this folding screen.

examples.japanese: {江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}の{屏風絵|びょうぶえ}は{金箔|きんぱく}を{使|つか}ったものが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many Edo-period folding-screen paintings use gold leaf.

notes:
A traditional painting format using the surface of a {屏風|びょうぶ}; many famous works (e.g. {風神雷神図|ふうじんらいじんず}) are {屏風絵|びょうぶえ}.

RELATED WORDS:
- {屏風|びょうぶ}: folding screen
- {襖絵|ふすまえ}: paintings on sliding doors — a related architectural-painting format
